svg.title: QuickControl system architecture
svg.desc: An agent or reusable MCP client sends calls through the upstream Windows MCP ownership gate. FillForm and Sequence reuse upstream tools. UIA work preserves control context on the original worker; rapid Type sends bounded Unicode chunks through the input ledger to Windows. Screenshots and exact outcome checks close the observation loop. Cancellation drains native work before releasing the gate.
svg.text: QUICKCONTROL / SYSTEM DESIGN
Fewer round trips. Bounded native input.
A startup adapter around CursorTouch Windows MCP — with its ownership gate retained.
AI agent / directly exposed MCP tools
Observe the current UI, then choose the next action.
Existing direct-tool connections already stay open.
Fallback client: quickcontrol.py
